What to Expect?

Initial Call – Speak with our care coordinator to understand your concern

Consult with an expert – Book an in-depth consultation with a specialist.

Assessment – Receive structured evaluations (as needed).

Therapy Plan – A tailored plan designed with your goals in mind.

Progress Review – Ongoing monitoring and collaborative feedback.

Frequently asked questions

Yes, parent involvement is crucial, especially for younger children. We also provide separate parent coaching.

Free · 2 minutes · no sign-up

Not sure whether what you are seeing is a delay?

Our milestone checker asks eight age-specific questions and gives you a domain-by-domain snapshot — speech, motor, social, play and behaviour — on screen straight away. It will tell you plainly if your child is on track, and it comes with a free parent guide either way.
